properties.description:
The existing panel is antiquated and showing signs that it may be failing. ERA believes that the battery charging circuit is no longer charging the batteries. In a building of this size, it is recommended that the system is upgraded to a fully addressable system that can identify the issue to a precise location as opposed to a zone. This technology was not available when this system was originally installed. Along with precise locations, the additional benefit includes false alarm reduction of smoke detectors as new devices are intelligent and can identify a panel of issues before going into a false alarm state. Replace as follows:

(1) SK6820 Addressable Fire Alarm Control Panel with 6815 Expander

(3) Power Supplies replaced with 5496 Intelligent Power Supplies

(2) 6860 Remote Annunciators to replace lobby panels

(136) SK-PHOTO-W Smoke Detectors to replace existing smokes

(2) SK-HEAT-W Heat Detector to replace existing heat

(42) SK-PULL-DA Dual Action Pull Stations to replace existing pulls

(4) Monitor Modules for sprinkler system monitoring

(6) Relay Modules for elevator recall operations

(4) SK-ISO6 Isolation Modules inside cabinets to isolated by existing zones

All A/V devices to remain and all existing wiring to be re-used as per NFPA 72
